text:
Alex (support): Heads-up: enterprise customer 'NimbleApps' reporting p99 spikes after SentryFlux onboarding. p95 ~300ms stable, p99 jumped from ~220ms -> ~2.1s for inputs >8k tokens since we flipped tokenizer=subword-splitter-v3 yesterday. Seeing correlated auth retries from client 401->retry loop (low freq) but main issue looks latency.

Jamie (ml-eng): thx. any request IDs or sample payloads? can you paste a curl that reproduces?

Alex (support): pasted a repro curl from the customer's payload (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"sentryflux-v2","input":"<very long doc ~9k tokens>","stream":false}'
```

Alex (support): Observed:
- k8s pod logs show kvcache miss-rate jump from 3% -> 42% for these calls
- runtime CPU single-token loop shows long-run on slowpath (tokenization expansion + chunking)
- no obvious OOMs
- customer noticed cost spike (they hit billing alert).

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0421, paging eng-infra.

Sara (infra): I see the pod-level traces for the request IDs Alex sent. The runtime spends ~1.6s in token preproc + chunking for these requests, then ~200ms generate. Tokenizer v3 seems to expand some CJK/emoji sequences into more subtokens than v1 -> longer effective sequence length and more KV writes.

Jamie (ml-eng): that jives. subword-splitter-v3 introduced a normalization step that splits ambiguous byte sequences (good for accuracy) but increases token count for combined inputs. Combined with our new KV-chain compaction in v2 model, we're hitting more KV chain rehashing and cache churn.

Matt (product): Customer is on Dedicated with reserved capacity; SLA breathing room but they flagged latency to end-users and billing. Short term fixes we can offer?

Alex (support): Proposed mitigation we told them: 1) set model to `sentryflux-v1` (pin) 2) add per-route fallback to `sentryflux-lite` for payloads >6k tokens 3) enable runtime flag `kvcache_warmup=true` on their pool (manual)

Sara (infra): I can flip kvcache_warmup on their dedicated pool now (will briefly restart 3 pods). Will also temporarily increase kvcache size by 20% for that pool. Deploy ETA ~8m.

Jamie (ml-eng): longer-term: revert tokenizer normalization in subword-splitter-v3 or add an opt-in `normalize_unicode=false` per-customer. Also we should add a pre-tokenization heuristic that rejects expansion >x% and routes to streaming/segmented path. I'll open an RFC.

Alex (support): customer accepted the pin+warmup for now, will monitor. Also they reported some 401s hitting during retries earlier — looks like client-side token refresh mis-timed with retries, inflating request volume, may have exacerbated cache churn. We asked them to backoff and fix token refresh.

Matt (product): Can we offer a credit for the billing spike? ops: depends on total cost delta. support: collect usage windows with timestamps.

Jamie (ml-eng): Repro steps for eng to reproduce locally:
```
python tools/repro_long_input.py --model sentryflux-v2 --tokenizer subword-splitter-v3
  --file samples/nimble_long.json --trace-kv=true --kv-debug
```
Outputs: KV miss-rate, token expansion ratio, per-token slowpath time.

Sara (infra): After I flip warmup + size bump, I'll watch p99. If still >1s we'll rollback tokenizer for that customer's pool or add a routing rule to send >6k token requests to the lite model.

Alex (support): I'll relay to customer and keep thread updated. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

(oncall-bot): INC-2026-0421 updated: kvcache warmup toggled for customer pool, monitor p99 for next 30m.

Jamie (ml-eng): Followups: create a small canary test that simulates token expansion worst-case and run on staging with current kernel selection. I'm logging a ticket MLENG-1459 to track tokenizer revert vs opt-out.

Matt (product): Also add a Docs note about tokenizer change and expected token-expansion impact for long inputs; avoid surprises for Dedicated customers.

Alex (support): Last note: customer will share full payload samples (sanitized) in a secure upload. Once received we'll run repro and confirm.

Sara (infra): p99 trending: preflip 2.1s -> after warmup bump 420ms in first 10m sample. Will continue to monitor and report back in thread.
